##### Project general facts

Hyde Walk by Imtiaz is a residential project crafted for design enthusiasts, built on a clear vision to offer far more than just a place to live. The collection is curated to suit diverse lifestyles, presenting a meticulously designed array of living spaces that includes stylish studios and contemporary 1-bedroom apartments. From the cozy charm of the studios to the modern elegance of the one-bedroom homes, every residence blends modern sophistication with a warmth that makes it a truly tranquil retreat.

Life at Hyde Walk is elevated by a wonderful set of shared spaces, crowned by a rooftop pool deck with infinity pools for both families and adults, a shaded terrace and sun-loungers that make it the perfect vantage point for sunset. The fully equipped gym is a realm of wellness where strength meets luxury, welcoming seasoned fitness enthusiasts and beginners alike with state-of-the-art equipment and a dynamic atmosphere. Residents also enjoy the Hyde Clubhouse and club room as a chic social hub for gatherings and celebrations, along with extra visitors parking, an electric vehicle recharge station and a meticulously crafted entrance that turns every arrival into a red-carpet moment.

The residences come fully furnished and are designed with a keen eye for detail, creating homes that are as beautiful as they are comfortable. Bathed in natural light pouring through floor-to-ceiling windows, the kitchens redefine modern elegance with sleek black accents set against an elevated neutral palette, ingenious storage solutions, top-notch appliances and a grand island that becomes the heart of the home. The bathrooms are equally inviting sanctuaries for self-care, where warm finishes, intricate detailing, subtle ambient lighting, ample hidden storage and a generous rain shower come together in a perfect blend of style and practicality.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Garden City is a prime area located in the heart of Dubai, known for its strategic positioning and accessibility. Situated close to Sheikh Zayed Road, one of Dubai’s main arterial roads, the area provides residents and businesses with easy access to key parts of the city, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and the Dubai International Airport. This location makes it a highly sought-after spot for both residential and commercial developments, catering to professionals, families, and businesses looking for a central and convenient setting.

The area is designed to offer a balanced blend of urban living and natural beauty, featuring a mix of high-rise buildings, mid-rise residential complexes, and villas surrounded by lush landscaping. Jumeirah Garden City is planned to include extensive green spaces, parks, and water features, creating a serene environment amidst the urban landscape. This integration of nature within the city is intended to promote a sense of community and well-being among its residents, offering a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life.

In addition to its residential offerings, Jumeirah Garden City host a variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and entertainment options, making it a self-sufficient neighborhood with everything residents need within easy reach. The development aims to enhance the quality of life for its inhabitants by providing modern amenities, recreational facilities, and community spaces that encourage social interaction and a healthy lifestyle. Its commitment to combining luxury living with environmental sustainability and urban convenience makes Jumeirah Garden City a unique and desirable destination in Dubai.
